title_zh: 先试调一排货架再考虑全面搬动

scenario.label_zh: 先试调一排货架再考虑全面搬动
scenario.goal_zh: 根据盘点结果讨论空间收益，并约定先用一排货架测试新布局

context_zh: 仓库负责人和同事在盘点后讨论是否值得大规模重排货架。
author: author-phase11-b

sentences.speaker: Anika
sentences.text: The inventory is finished. Half the boxes on this side are empty packaging.

sentences.speaker: Ross
sentences.text: Then do we need the large-scale move we discussed?

sentences.speaker: Anika
sentences.text: Perhaps not. Removing the packaging frees most of the space we wanted. Moving every shelf would give us only a marginal gain.

sentences.speaker: Ross
sentences.text: I still want to maximize the usable space, but not if it takes the team away from orders all week.

sentences.speaker: Anika
sentences.text: Let's try the new arrangement on one row. We can measure the space and see whether picking orders becomes awkward.

sentences.speaker: Ross
sentences.text: Agreed. One row first, then we'll decide whether the rest is worth moving.
